name: Jina AI
tagline: Jina AI provides open-source and cloud-based infrastructure for building multimodal AI applications, including embedding models, rerankers, and a reader API that converts web pages to LLM-friendly text. Its tools are used to build search, RAG, and retrieval pipelines.
